en: [to himself] Just my luck.
[not looking up] It doesn't.
[projecting from the cashier] Hey, look with your eyes, not your hands, okay?
[projecting from the cashier] Just do me a favor and put it down, please?
[projecting from the cashier] That's like, one of the most expensive things we have in here.
[projecting from the cashier] And I know you don't have the scratch to cover it, so...
[projecting from the cashier] Okay, let's not-- please, just...
[projecting from the cashier] And the last time we woke it up before it was ready it nearly burned down the shop, so just... ease off.
[projecting from the cashier] Phoenix's are endangered, alright?
And what did I say about talking, Jack?
[projecting from the cashier] Phoenixes...
[projecting from the cashier] And the last time we woke it up before it was ready to reform it nearly burned down the shop, so just... ease off.
Because that bird's a misadventure waiting to happen.
You got bullets for this thing?
[muttering to himself] Pecos Bill's Revolver.
[projecting from the cashier] What was that?
Haven't seen him around for a while.
[to himself] Yeah, well, uh... what can I say.
[projecting from the cashier] Blacksmith didn't need it.
What's the anvil for?
This is Prince Lawrence's dagger...
Who sold this?
Did he sell this?
[projecting from the cashier] I don't know.
[projecting from the cashier] A dagger isn't exactly the axe, so, uh...
[projecting from the cashier] It's hard to keep track.
[projecting from the cashier] Look, are you almost done?
[projecting from the cashier] You're not touching anything, are you?
O-- Okay, then.
[projecting from the cashier] Who cares, really.
[projecting from the cashier] I'm not here every day. And even when I am here, people sometimes dump boxes of shit.
How can you "not know" who pawned it?
[projecting from the cashier] What does it matter?
[projecting from the cashier] I'm not wholly without charm.
You're being even less helpful than I anticipated, do you know that.
Why would he pawn this?
Why would Lawrence do something like that...
[projecting from the cashier] You don't know how hard most of us have it... do you?
[projecting from the cashier] Because he's poor, that's why.
Who would have pawned this?
Who would have done that? One of the Tweedles...
[projecting from the cashier] Whoever did it, must've needed the money bad. Which shouldn't come as a total shock.
[mostly to himself] It's just... sad to see it here, like this.
[projecting from the cashier] Oh, please. I've seen Fables sell the clothes off their back.
[projecting from the cashier] Oh please. Sad is watching Dickory Dock sell the mouse and the clock so he can afford clean sheets.
There's nothin' else you're forgetting to tell me...
No, just please don't break anything, alright?
[sarcastic] Oh please, don't mind me...
[sing-songy] Alriiiiight. Don't let me get in your way.
[lying]We'd never take something like that.
Whatever it is, though, it sure as shit wasn't the Woodsman's.
[projecting from the cashier] Nope.
[projecting from the cashier] Don't get all wistful. It's just an overdone spork.
I know what it's like.
You're better off than you think.
You try being Sheriff.
It was a rhetorical question... but sure, fine.
No.[beat] I know how it is.
You and Gren and Toad... you're all better off than you think.
Yeah? If you had my job, you wouldn't get out of bed.
[projecting from the cashier] I've seen folks dump shit you wouldn't believe.
[nervous]Uh, yeah?
Bought what.
Who bought it.
[more firm] The axe.
I don't know anything about that.
[nervous] I don't. Really.
Really!
[nervous] I mean, I don't work every day, so...
I didn't know there was ever any axe here.
Was who here.
[more firm] Bloody Mary.[beat] Because the axe was here... but it's gone. And she had it. So she was here.
The axe was right here all along. Now tell me what happened to it.
Okay, c'mon, Bigby, that wasn't--[gets cut off]
You're a lying piece of shit, Jack.
[nervous]Look, I don't know anything, alright?
And even when I do work, I just try and keep my head down.
Just tell me the truth. What happened to the axe.
Last chance.[beat] What happened to the axe.
[being punched in the face] Aaahh!
Okay, okay, fuckin' geez, take it easy..
What happened to the axe.
[sighs] It was Mary, she took it, okay, that's all I know!
She come here often? Do you know where she lives, have an address or...
[tired] I don't know, man.
I'm being straight, here! I'm just part-time.
Why'd she take it? Just to fuck with me?
You think I'm crazy enough to ask her that? I'm not sticking my foot in that lawnmower, thank you.
Why did she want THIS axe?
Where does she live?
Did she tell you anything?
But I'm smart enough to not ask questions, alright?
Sometimes it's for her...
She sometimes comes in to pick up shit.
Sometimes it's for the Crooked Man.
I mean, it's Jersey who's the one who's into this stuff! He's one of the Crooked Man's boys, okay?
Well, for your sake, you better think of something to tell me.
That's all I can tell you.
You know where she lives? Where she took it?
I don't where that crazy chick lives, and I don't wanna know.
She say anything about... about the Crooked Man's plans... about Crane..?
What, you think we're friends? I try not to even look that crazy chick in the eye.
I don't know anything, and I don't want to know anything.
It's not my fuckin' system.
But you-- you're the guy who makes sure that--[gets cut off]
What's the-- what's the point of havin' a system if you're just gonna--[gets cut off]
I'm the guy that keeps shit in order and that's it, Woody.
I didn't pawn it, asshole. It was stolen from my apartment.
If you love your axe so fuckin' much, why'd you pawn it in the first fuckin' place, huh?
Now tell me where it is right fuckin' now.
[cold] I think while tempers are running high...
[relaxed] Woody. Calm down. Your axe isn't here.
Bigby? What-- it isn't?
[casual] It's Jersey, right? Jersey Devil?
Bigby?[beat] What are you--[gets cut off]
I have some questions for you, myself.
Just like I said, it's not here.[beat] Happy?
Nope. It isn't.
Is his axe even here?
Uh, guys... no rough housing while Dad's home, okay?
Get a latch for your window, what do you want from me.
[firm] Yes. We are.
[cold] ...we should keep demands to a minimum.
[cold] Okay?
I want you tell me where my axe is!
And I'm sure you want something, so what the fuck is it so I can get the Hell out of here.
Wait, we're not finished yet.
And it'd be great if he was here to tell you all this, but he's not, so just--[gets cut off]
Jersey, don't-- don't give me that shit. What the fuck is the point of havin' a system if you're just gonna--[gets cut off]
So just like I said, it's not here.[beat] Happy?
Fire code not up to the Business Office's standards?
If I were you, I'd watch my tone about now.
Well that's just the thing, I'm not you. I work for a living.
Gren said that he saw it here.
I got shit to do, so whatever you're here for, make it snappy.
You're talking to me now.
You're dealing with me, now. Okay?
And Gren said that he saw it here.
Uh.... he wanted to know where--[gets cut off]
Actually, you know what, I don't care what he wanted.
You work with the Crooked Man.
Yeah.[beat] What of it.
I don't think your permission carries a lot of weight nowadays.
I mean... after what happened this morning.
How's your head? Feelin' alright?
Oh. Really.
Mr. uh, Devil, sir, the Sheriff here wanted to know about Woody's axe, too, so...[trails off]
How's your arm?[beat] Bloody Mary leaves a bit of a sting, don't she?
You see... the Sheriff had who he stupidly thought was the murderer... been chasing him for fuckin' days, right?
Jack, did you know that as of this very morning, Bigby's joined the Crooked Man's obedience school for wayward fucking creatures? He's already passed his first class.
Told me himself.
I just wanna say thanks.
Which of course he very much appreciated.
So, you know, on behalf of the organization...
Tell me what you know!
Fuck you, Jersey.
But the Crooked Man snapped his bony fingers[snaps fingers]... and Bigby handed him over just... like... that.
Didn't happen like that.
[cold] Tell me everything you know right now about the murders, and the Crooked Man.
[cold] I wouldn't exactly put it like that.
[very angry] Listen, you bald little dipshit, you're gonna--[gets punched]
Are you kidding me! It was here, it was right fuckin' here!
How the fuck do I know?
What'd you do with it?
[angry] Are you outta your fuckin' mind?
[angry] ...just so I can prove to you that your axe isn't here...
[angry] You follow me here all the way from Battery fucking Park...
[angry] And you think I'm gonna take another inch of abuse?
[Punch Jersey]
Hey! Back off!
Take it easy...
[Restrain Woody]
Nice one.
Will everyone stop!
Oh geez, c'mon now guys, let's not...
Oh what the fuck are you gonna do?
Hey! Back off and settle down!
Hey, take it easy, leave the guy alone.
Maybe I don't want to, alright?
[to himself] Fuckin' guy.
Fuck off, he started it!
Woody, ease off!
Mm. Nice one.
Always a slimy fuckin'...
Jesus, will everyone calm the fuck down!
Fuck me!
[seething; in pain] Even Crane had to use the Magic Mirror...
[seething; in pain] You can't find the Crooked Man.[beat] No one can.
The Magic Mirror?
{Body-StandA}{AngryE}So... {AngryD}wanna try again?
[getting sleepy] Yeah... the "Magic Mirror."...
I can't use the mirror.
How do YOU contact him?
Why should I trust you?
[non-verbal][snorts]
Fuckin' shit...
[bitterly pleased] {body-stomach}Oh no? Why not.
{Body-crouch}{AngryD}I can't use the Magic Mirror right now.
{Body-crouch}{AngryD}Okay, that's Crane's way... {AngryC}how do you contact him?
{body-stomach}[seething; in pain] I don't. He uses couriers for everything. Ravens, goblins, the fuckin' Tweedles... whatever. I go in when I'm taken there.
[bitter, in pain, laugh] Would this face lie to you?
[quietly threatening] {Body-StandA}{AngryD}Convince me that I should trust you.
Alright, enough of this shit.
{ThinkingB}Well it's a good thing I don't have any, then.
{Body-StandA}[wrenching an axe out of someone's head]
{ThinkingA}There we go. {NormalA}Good as new.
[seething; in pain] I'm gonna eat... your fuckin' children, Woody... feet first.
[non-verbal][in physical, awkward pain]
[cold] {AngryE}Because I just can't, that's why.
[tired; bitter] That it's missing a piece.
[tired; bitter] But you should talk to the Butcher about that.
[tired; bitter] You don't know anything... about anything, do you.[beat] What do you have?[beat] Nothin'.
What's that.
Who's the Butcher?
[tired; bitter] Does what he's told.
That fuck up?
[tired; bitter] Oh, he's not so bad...
[groggy, head injury] Mirror, mirror...
Enlighten me.
Tell me where the Crooked Man is.
[seething; in pain] There's no address, no place... he lives in the bends and forks of tree roots... behind the sun... in the[coughing]... shadows.
[seething; in pain] The door to his house... it bounces around. Never in one spot.[beat] You'll never find it.
{AngryE}That's not good enough.
[tired; bitter] Your precious mirror's broken and you're left with nothin'.
How do you know it's broken?
{Body-crouch}{AngryB}Where did you hear it got broken?
{body-stomach}Oh. That.[beat] Gossip flies fast. We're like a sewing circle.
I also know where to get its missing piece.
Oh yeah? I got you.
[tired] Look, I know where to get the missing shard of the mirror... alright?
{body-crouch}{AngryB}Nothing?[beat] {AngryC}I still have you, don't I?
[tired; in pain] Yes, you do.
[Stomp him]
[angry] {Body-StandA}{AngryB}The next thing you say {AngryD}better be something useful.
[seething in pain] I know where to get the missing piece of the fuckin' mirror, okay?
[whining with pain] Owwww!
[tired; in pain] No fuckin' friends.
[tired; in pain] And no clue about who is really runnin' this town.
[tired; in pain] A useless cunt of a Deputy.
[tired; bitter] Just a useless cunt of a Deputy...
[tired; bitter] That useless bitch, Snow White, and a broken fuckin' mirror....
[big sigh] If it's anywhere, it'd be with the Butcher.
The, uh, the Magic Mirror?
{Body-crouch}{AngryB}Will Mary be there?
[tired] It's a bit of a... cottage industry.
{body-stomach}[groaning, groggy]You want me to draw you a picture? I don't fucking know...
[seething in pain; tired] It's not, it's not... it's where they take all the magic shit that gets sold around town, alright?
{Body-crouch}{AngryB}Why just tell me this? {ThinkingB}Are you trying to rush me out of here?
{body-stomach}[seething in pain; tired] So that's it. Okay? That's what you want, so go fuckin' get it. Or... you can at least try...
[tired; in pain] If they're dead, it's cause the Crooked Man wanted them dead.[beat]That's all it takes.
[casually] I'm taking this.
[tired; in pain] It doesn't fuckin' matter... you know that, right?
Thanks again, Bigby, for another, uh, interesting experience...
[tired; in pain] And there's nothin' you can do...to bring them back.
[tired; in pain][one last thing]Hey... Sheriff.
[in pain; tired] Cause you ain't gettin'... no reparations.
[in pain; tired] Not a God... damned... thing.
[in pain; tired] So I hope this little adventure fills you up somehow.
This is for me, Jersey. Not them.
I can still get the ones responsible.
[in pain; tired] [light laughing to passing out]
{Body-StandA}{ConfusedA}Got a smoke?
[Give him one]
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingB}Fresh out.
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingB}Thanks.
So what's left between us, huh.
What do I look like?
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingB}What do I look like, huh?
{Body-StandA}{AngryA}You really wanna know?
[angrier]And I won't be too quick to forget what happened in that jail cell, either.
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingA}Don't think that mess back there makes us even.[beat] {AngryA}It doesn't.
[serious]{NormalA}I don't care how many corners you turn.[beat] {AngryA}You're still just a wolf to me.
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingA}And you're still the Woodsman, {ThinkingB}holding onto your axe like it's your mother's fuckin' milk.
[chuckle] {Body-StandA}{DrunkA}Uh huh.
{Body-StandA}{HappyA}And that's {NormalA}just how I'd like to keep it.
{Body-StandA}{ThinkingB}I don't really give a shit how you see me, Woody.
[chuckling] {Body-StandA}{DrunkA}Yeah, I know.
{ThinkingA}Yeah.
[alt]So you gonna stop fuckin' around and get the guy who did it?
You gonna be OK?
